skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, roles, and national regulations regarding the planning and conservation of natural resources.
Apply knowledge to identify types and contents of natural resource planning and conservation.
Analyze and apply basic measures to organize and implement natural resource planning and conservation.
Work individually and in groups to choose topics and solve economic, financial, and business problems using natural resource planning and conservation tools.
Analyze and evaluate the planning and conservation of natural resources in Vietnam and globally.
Effectively present research findings and engage in discussions.
Conduct research and analyze data related to natural resource management.
Evaluate the environmental impact of resource exploitation projects.
Manage and coordinate group projects and presentations.
Apply economic principles to natural resource planning and conservation.
